model_families.rationale: Stable deterministic Bass fit, prediction, simulation, summary, diagnostics, and bounded fitted-state payloads have Rust-native coverage.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting covariate, event, custom fitter, or probabilistic Bass payloads.

model_families.rationale: Stable deterministic Logistic fit, prediction, simulation, summary, diagnostics, and bounded fitted-state payloads have Rust-native coverage.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting covariate, event, custom fitter, or probabilistic Logistic payloads.

model_families.rationale: Stable deterministic Gompertz fit, prediction, simulation, summary, diagnostics, and bounded fitted-state payloads have Rust-native coverage.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting covariate, event, custom fitter, or probabilistic Gompertz payloads.

model_families.rationale: Stable deterministic Fisher-Pry fit, prediction, simulation, summary, diagnostics, and bounded fitted-state payloads have Rust-native coverage.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting richer Python internals or non-deterministic substitution payloads.

model_families.rationale: Narrow single-generation deterministic Norton-Bass prediction, simulation, summary, and diagnostics are Rust-native.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit before claiming multi-generation, covariate, or event payload ownership.

model_families.rationale: Composite orchestration depends on Python object internals and lacks parity, schema, and error-mapping fixtures for Rust promotion.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit when composite parity fixtures, stable orchestration schema, and error mapping fixtures exist.

model_families.rationale: Multi-product competition uses model-specific state, covariates, and interaction payloads that are not stable for Rust ownership.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit when multi-product state, covariate, and interaction schemas have stable fixtures.

model_families.rationale: ODE and state-vector payload ownership needs a separate deterministic solver and payload promotion decision.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after solver, state-vector schema, parity, and benchmark evidence are approved.

model_families.rationale: Ecosystem interaction semantics remain Python-reference-owned until schema fixtures exist.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit when ecosystem interaction fixtures and stable payload schemas are available.

model_families.rationale: Hierarchical and probabilistic semantics remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only with a stable hierarchy schema and posterior boundary decision.

model_families.rationale: Mixture semantics and uncertainty payloads remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after mixture component schema and uncertainty payload boundaries are stable.

model_families.rationale: Latent process and uncertainty payloads remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after latent-state schema and posterior payload decisions are complete.

model_families.rationale: Regime state and transition semantics remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after regime-state and transition schemas are stable.

model_families.rationale: Network object internals and graph schemas remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after graph and agent-state schema ownership is decided.

model_families.rationale: Policy hazard semantics and diagnostics remain Python-reference-owned.
model_families.revisit_condition: Revisit only after policy intervention and hazard diagnostic schemas are stable.

payload_shapes.rationale: Bounded fitted-state payloads have explicit model keys, parameters, predict kwargs, and numeric time arrays.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when fitted state includes Python object internals or richer model-specific state.

payload_shapes.rationale: Positive time and observed arrays are stable fit payloads for promoted deterministic model slices.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when fit payloads include weights, events, covariates, or custom fitter options.

payload_shapes.rationale: Covariate semantics differ by model family and need separate schema fixtures before Rust promotion.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when model-family-specific covariate schemas and parity fixtures exist.

payload_shapes.rationale: Event split semantics are not stable across diffusion, substitution, and policy models.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when event split semantics are normalized across model families.

payload_shapes.rationale: Promoted native slices reject missing parameters or incomplete fitted states with stable errors; ownership is limited to rejection behavior.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit if partial fitted-state recovery or repair becomes a product requirement.

payload_shapes.rationale: Bounded residual metrics, warnings, support level, provenance, and comparison family have stable deterministic diagnostic payload coverage.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit before claiming posterior, covariate-aware, or Python-internal diagnostics.

payload_shapes.rationale: Deterministic fitted-state simulation over explicit numeric time arrays is stable and Rust-native.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting stochastic policies or simulator object state.

payload_shapes.rationale: Stochastic policies need explicit seed, PRNG, and shape contracts before Rust or XLA promotion.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when seed, PRNG, and shape contracts are accepted.

payload_shapes.rationale: Probabilistic posterior, uncertainty, and backend-specific diagnostics remain Python-reference-owned.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when posterior interchange and uncertainty schema ownership are explicitly designed.

payload_shapes.rationale: Network, ABM, ecosystem, and policy object internals remain Python-reference-owned.
payload_shapes.revisit_condition: Revisit when graph, agent, and ecosystem state schemas are stable.

canonical_operations.rationale: Packaged discovery metadata is native and has manifest parity evidence.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit when discovery schema or packaged metadata changes.

canonical_operations.rationale: Stable deterministic fit payloads are promoted, while covariate, event, custom fitter, probabilistic, and uncertainty-aware payloads remain explicit boundaries.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit before widening fit defaults to covariate, event, custom fitter, probabilistic, or uncertainty-aware payloads.

canonical_operations.rationale: Stable deterministic fitted-state prediction slices are promoted; unsupported model-family and Python-internal payloads remain explicit boundaries.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit before claiming custom horizons that require Python internals or non-deterministic state.

canonical_operations.rationale: Stable deterministic fitted-state simulation slices are promoted; stochastic and Python-internal payloads remain explicit boundaries.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit before promoting stochastic policies or simulator object internals.

canonical_operations.rationale: Stable deterministic fitted-state reporting slices are promoted; rich model-card, posterior, and Python-internal summary payloads remain explicit Python boundaries.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit before claiming rich model-card, posterior, or Python-internal summary ownership.

canonical_operations.rationale: Stable deterministic fitted-state diagnostic slices are promoted; posterior, covariate, rich residual, and Python-internal diagnostic payloads remain explicit boundaries.
canonical_operations.revisit_condition: Revisit before claiming posterior, covariate-aware, rich residual, or Python-internal diagnostic ownership.
